# <span id="aanchor281"></span> Line Pack Meters

Pipeline inventory, or line pack, is managed in FLOWCAL via a meter type called “Line Pack”. Line pack meter periodics reflect pipeline inventory at a particular time period. The meter rollup process calculates changes in pipeline inventory from one period to the next.

To create a line pack meter in FLOWCAL, set the meter type to “Line Pack” in the meter’s characteristics.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Gas Line Pack">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Gas Line Pack Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Gas Line Pack">

Gas line pack meters in FLOWCAL use the same parameters as AGA-7 meters, except that users can either provide the raw volume (provided with each periodic) or let FLOWCAL calculate it based on pipe length and diameter (meter characteristics).

Temperature, pressure, and an analysis that satisfies the selected Z Method are required to calculate volume and energy.

<div class="procedure">

To create a gas line pack meter:

1.  Create a new gas meter in the Meter Editor.
2.  Go to the Volume Editor and open the meter characteristics.
3.  Set the meter type and calculation method to “Line Pack”, and set the Z Method.
4.  If you want FLOWCAL to calculate raw volume, enter the pipe diameter and pipe length.
5.  Enter the pressure base, temperature base, pressure gauge, atmospheric pressure, and other information as needed.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 560;height: 313;" />

Pipe diameter and pipe length units default to the FLOWCAL system units. The default units for the meter can be changed on the Units tab of the meter’s characteristics.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Liquid Line Pack">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Liquid Line Pack Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Liquid Line Pack">

For liquid line pack meters, if you need FLOWCAL to calculate the mass and volume, the calculation method must be set to API 12.2 (Liq Volumetric) and a product must be selected. You can choose the Data Only calculation method if you will be providing mass and volume.

Observed temperature, observed pressure, observed density, meter temperature and meter pressure are required to calculate GSV, NSV, and mass. If an analysis is applied, gas equivalent volume, energy, component volume, and component mass are calculated.

Indicated volume can be entered for each record, or you can set the line pack volume on the Operations tab of the meter’s characteristics.

The calculation for each record will use a volumetric calculation based on a water volume for the pipe that the meter represents. A water volume can be specified on the Operations tab of the meter’s characteristics. This will be the default uncorrected volume, although each record can be imported or edited with its own uncorrected volume.

<div class="procedure">

To create a new liquid line pack meter:

1.  Create a new liquid meter in the Meter Editor.
2.  From the Volume Editor, go to the meter’s characteristics.
3.  Set the meter type to “Line Pack” and the calculation method to “API 12.2 (Liq Volumetric)” or “Data Only”.
4.  Select a product.
5.  Set the meter factor, pressure gauge and atmospheric pressure. If the meter factor is not set, a value of 1.0 will be used.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 557;height: 324;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Line Pack Batches">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Line Pack Batches</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Line Pack Batches">

Line pack batches are typically created via the [Batch Scheduler utility](../Settings%20Manager/Liquids/Batch%20Scheduler%20Utility.md). ACBI batches will be created for periods in which no defined batches exist.

Line pack batches can only be rolled up from periodics. Consequently:

- Line pack batches cannot be imported; and
- Line pack batch flow data cannot be edited.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Rollups">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Data Rollups</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Rollups">

The Rollup Viewer displays changes in line pack data between the current record and the previous record as well as the inventory.

FLOWCAL uses the latest value of each period for the inventory, so the change represents the activity during the period, and the line pack inventory represents the total line pack inventory at the end of the period. When viewing monthly data for the current month, for example, the values will represent the net change since the end of last month and the latest known total line pack of the segment or section. Similarly, the last hour of each day is taken as the value for that day, and the last day of the month is taken as the value for that month.

The following table demonstrates this calculation using a three-hour day and a three-day month:

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Inventory Locations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Line Pack Meters in Inventory Locations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Inventory Locations">

Inventory locations, created within the Location Editor, are also available for line pack meters to calculate the total amount of inventory as well as the change in that inventory. The rollup action for hourly data sums the line pack inventories and change amounts from the corresponding hours of all location members (members may be line pack meters or other inventory locations). The rollup action for daily and monthly inventory data takes the latest chronological value for each period to the next resolution level and calculates the difference from the previous record.

Location rollups include the change volume from a line pack meter or inventory location when calculating the gain/loss for a segment or a balance.

The Rollup Viewer displays the changes in volume, energy, and mass from one record to the next. The total inventory is also displayed for volume, energy, and mass.

When adding multiple line pack meters into one inventory location (created in the Location Editor), the meter data resolutions must match.

</div>
